Mathura Cemetery: JCB Damages Graves, Sparks Controversy

Nine graves in a 117-year-old Muslim cemetery in Mathura were reportedly damaged by a JCB. The Muslim Cemetery Committee has described the incident as an 'insult to the dead'. The municipal corporation has offered 100 rupees in compensation for the damaged graves, a sum that has drawn criticism. This incident has raised concerns regarding the respect for burial sites and the adequacy of compensation for such damage.
